cause.source: @vercel/fs-detectors dist/detect-builders.js (getRouteResult): with a build from a root api/ folder and a framework without ignoreRuntimes (SvelteKit has none), Vercel adds { src: '^/api(/.*)?$', status: 404 } to the rewrite routes
cause.effect: SvelteKit /api routes that are function files (/api/e, /api/analytics, /api/releases-snapshot) match in the filesystem phase and work; the dynamic one (/api/update/[target]/[arch]/[version]) needs a rewrite after it and gets Vercel's 404

local_after.mode: pnpm preview --mode verify (no production env file, so no Resend key or analytics store)
local_after.build_output: api/contact.func added; config.json routes ^/api/contact/? and ^/api/update/([^/]+?)/([^/]+?)/([^/]+?)/? to their functions; no root api/ folder left
local_after.contact form without Origin: 403 (SvelteKit; browsers always send Origin on POST)
local_after.contact form in the browser: POST /api/contact 500, note 'The form is unavailable. Email studio@timothyali.com directly.'
